meta.name: Arena Training landing page reconstruction
meta.coordinateSystem: Pixels measured against the 1004 x 1567 reference. Percentages are preferred in implementation.
meta.visualIntent: Premium urban gym landing page, performance-driven, cinematic, high contrast and conversion focused.

motion.reducedMotion: Disable image scale and smooth scroll when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

globalLayout.headerBehavior: Absolute over hero on first load; becomes compact, fixed and translucent after scrolling.

eyebrow.layout: Inline flex, text followed by a 16px horizontal rule

primaryButton.icon: right arrow when the action navigates deeper
primaryButton.hover: Lift 2px, brighten red and expose a stronger shadow

outlineButton.hover: Fill with border color and invert text

imageTreatment.darkAreas: cinematic black overlay with red practical lighting
imageTreatment.hover: Subtle 1.025 scale only on interactive cards

sectionTitle.colorRule: Primary line inherits section foreground; highlighted phrase uses red.

background.overlay: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,.98) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,.72) 34%, rgba(0,0,0,.08) 69%, rgba(0,0,0,.25) 100%), linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,.35), transparent 45%)

sections.ux: Primary conversion is duplicated in header, hero copy and price card. On mobile the content stacks with the price card directly after the headline; benefits become a horizontal scroll or 3-row list.

headline: Há mais de 12 anos
cuidando de vidas
copyColumn.body: Na Arena Training, treino vai além de movimento. É disciplina, motivação e apoio para você alcançar sua melhor versão. Aqui, cada detalhe é pensado para o seu resultado.

gallery.grid: 3 columns x 2 rows; large image spans first 2 columns and both rows

sections.ux: Story and credibility metrics precede the facilities gallery. On mobile the large photo is full width, followed by two equal thumbnails.

headline: Movimento que
transforma
intro.body: Variedade de aulas para todos os níveis e objetivos.

carousel.navigation: Circular previous and next buttons at viewport edges; four pagination dots centered below.
carousel.cardComposition: Portrait image fills card; bottom 52px uses black gradient; red line icon and 10px white uppercase label sit together at bottom.

sections.ux: Cards are keyboard operable and swipeable. On narrow screens the intro remains above a snap-scrolling carousel with 1.25 cards visible.

background.decoration: red 3px dot matrix, vertically centered at right edge

headline: Escolha o plano
ideal para você
intro.body: Opções flexíveis para todos os objetivos. Treine com quem te motiva.

sections.ux: The recommended plan is visually elevated by a centered badge and filled CTA. On mobile cards stack with the recommended plan first.
Store badges use direct external links and include accessible labels. The cropped desktop phone becomes a complete centered mockup on mobile.

desktop.notes: Preserve the reference proportions while allowing additional breathing room on wider screens. Hero minimum height 700px.

tablet.notes: Collapse header navigation behind a menu button; hero price card stays to the right when space permits; about uses 40/60 columns; show 3.2 class cards.

mobile.notes: All main sections become a single column. Hero height becomes auto, navigation is a modal drawer, class cards use horizontal scroll snap, plan cards stack, app content centers.

accessibility.headingOrder: One h1 in hero; each following section starts with h2; cards use h3.
accessibility.contrast: White on black and black on off-white exceed WCAG AA. Red is not used alone to communicate meaning.
accessibility.images: Decorative images use empty alt; facility and class images have concise descriptive alt text.
accessibility.controls: All links and buttons expose visible focus, 44px mobile hit areas and descriptive accessible names.
accessibility.carousel: Previous/next controls, scroll snap fallback, aria-label on region and aria-current on pagination.

implementationNotes.strategy: Semantic static HTML, CSS custom properties, lightweight vanilla JavaScript and locally stored official-site assets.
implementationNotes.imagePolicy: Use official Arena Training assets when available; preserve aspect ratio with object-fit: cover; do not hotlink.
implementationNotes.linkPolicy: Use links discovered on arenatraining.com.br for plans, contact, class anchors and app badges; external links open safely in a new tab.
implementationNotes.performance: Preload logo and hero, lazy-load offscreen photos, explicit width/height, no framework dependency.

modernRevision.direction: High-fidelity, component-matched reconstruction of the Gymix page hierarchy for Arena Training: the same visual sequence, proportions, component families and responsive behavior are recreated with original HTML/CSS/JavaScript, official Arena imagery, Arena copy and the black/red brand system.
referencePatterns: Full-height photographic hero with dominant copy anchored over the image
Primary CTA paired with a circular directional icon
Alternating light and dark editorial sections with large vertical spacing
Asymmetric photo grids instead of repeated equal-sized cards
High-contrast pricing cards with imagery integrated into the card surface

exactComponentMap.hero: Full-viewport photo, overlay navigation, promotional capsule, oversized three-line heading, capsule CTA and proof row.
exactComponentMap.about: Centered manifesto followed by small portrait, experience metric/copy column and large portrait.
exactComponentMap.services: Dark asymmetric masonry of service cards with mixed compact, tall, wide and photographic tiles.
exactComponentMap.whyChoose: Large image paired with editorial copy, oversized metrics and a capsule CTA.
exactComponentMap.pricing: Two high-contrast split cards with integrated photography, price, features and directional CTA.
exactComponentMap.team: Three tall photographic cards with colored lower-third labels.
exactComponentMap.testimonials: Centered heading and mixed photo/quote masonry with accent and dark quote cards.
exactComponentMap.contact: Large contact photograph with overlaid information cards paired with a two-column booking form.
exactComponentMap.finalCta: Centered dark photographic panel with eyebrow, large headline and two actions.

contentCoverage: Contact, address, opening hours and social links

classScheduleModal.trigger: Every modality card is a native button with aria-haspopup=dialog.
classScheduleModal.surface: Native HTML dialog with a dynamic title, description, schedule groups, confirmation CTA and backdrop close.
classScheduleModal.accessibility: Focus moves to the close button, Escape closes the dialog and focus returns to the triggering card.

responsiveBehavior.desktop: 1180px content shell, four-column amenities and modality grid, two-column editorial sections.
responsiveBehavior.tablet: Two-column grids, mobile navigation, stacked editorial sections.
responsiveBehavior.mobile: Full-height photographic hero with its primary plan CTA above the fold; single-column sections and class cards; full-width modal actions; scrollable modal body and 44px minimum controls.

appShowcase.strategy: The low-resolution third-party phone screenshot was replaced by a code-native Arena product mockup inside a realistic device frame.
appShowcase.background: Official Arena gym photography with black and red grading.
appShowcase.accessibility: The mockup is illustrative and hidden from assistive technology; the adjacent copy contains the actual product information and link.

planCheckoutValidation.red: Validated on the current Sistema Pacto domain with plan id 24. Checkout identifies plano red training, charges R$ 9,90 initially and displays a R$ 114,90 monthly fee.
planCheckoutValidation.duplo: The official Arena source does not publish a self-service checkout for Plano Duplo. Its verified conversion path is the Arena Training WhatsApp request flow.
planCheckoutValidation.contact: The lead form was removed; contact now uses direct WhatsApp and telephone actions.

heroOffer.desktop: A bordered black offer panel floats on the right side of the photographic hero, with an oversized red R$ 9,90 initial charge, recurring fee, two benefits and a checkout CTA.
heroOffer.mobile: The headline scale is reduced and the offer becomes a 115px compact full-width strip at the bottom of the 760px hero, while the primary plans CTA remains visible with clear separation above it.
heroOffer.pricingAccuracy: R$ 9,90 is labeled as the first charge; R$ 114,90 is labeled as the monthly fee.

planCardRevision.imagery: No images are used in either membership card.
planCardRevision.red: Oferta Black; Plano Red; modern environment, advanced equipment and bonus discount on personalized training; R$ 9,90 in the first month; limited-time enrollment CTA.
planCardRevision.duplo: Plano Duplo; right to bring one additional person for 90 days at no cost; R$ 199,80; enrollment CTA through WhatsApp.
planCardRevision.visual: Gymix-inspired horizontal pricing panels: full-width stacked cards, restrained price hierarchy, pill CTA with circular arrow, divider and feature grid. Plano Red uses a dark surface and Plano Duplo uses the Arena red accent. No photography.
planCardRevision.desktop: One 1169px-wide card per row; measured heights of 431px for Red and 408px for Duplo at a 1280px viewport.
planCardRevision.mobile: Single-column card internals with compact price, full-width CTA and one-column feature list; validated at 390px and 360px without horizontal overflow.

mobileHeroRevision.headline: Reduced to a 36-40px responsive range.
mobileHeroRevision.offer: Compact 115px two-column strip at the bottom of the hero; price and recurring fee on the left, 142px CTA on the right; top is explicitly reset to auto so the panel cannot stretch vertically.

classPhotography.strategy: One generation call per modality for distinct subject matter and consistent art direction.
classPhotography.format: 1122x1402 PNG, vertical 4:5-style composition with darker lower band for interface copy.
classPhotography.responsiveCrop: Per-modality object-position values preserve the primary movement on desktop and mobile cards.
